import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static long n, c1 = 0, c2 = 0, result = 0;
    static long[] power = new long[20], sumArr = new long[10];
    static List<Long>[] bucket = new ArrayList[10];

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
            bucket[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
    }

    static final long MOD1 = 998244353;
    static final long MOD2 = 1000000007;

    static void doQuery(long p, long s) {
        for (int i = 0; i <= 6; ++i) {
            long val = ((s - p * power[i]) % MOD1 + MOD1) % MOD1;
            result = (result + val * bucket[i].size() + sumArr[i]) % MOD2;
            int idx = lowerBound(bucket[i], 998244353 - val);
            long count = bucket[i].size() - idx;
            result = (result - count * MOD1) % MOD2;
        }
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<Long> list, long key) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= key) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }

    static void generateNumbers(long x, int depth) {
        long tmp = ((c1++ - x) % MOD1 + MOD1) % MOD1;
        sumArr[depth] = (sumArr[depth] + tmp) % MOD2;
        bucket[depth].add(tmp);
        if (depth == 6) return;
        for (int d = 0; d <= 9; d++) {
            generateNumbers(x * 10 + d, depth + 1);
        }
    }

    static void processNumber(long x) {
        if (x > n) return;
        if ((x + 1) * 1000000L <= n + 1 && x * 10000000L > n) {
            doQuery(x, c2);
            c2 += c1;
        } else {
            long tmpVal = ((c2++ - x) % MOD1 + MOD1) % MOD1;
            result = (result + tmpVal) % MOD2;
            int start = (x != 0) ? 0 : 1;
            for (int i = start; i <= 9; i++) {
                processNumber(x * 10 + i);
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        n = Long.parseLong(br.readLine());
        generateNumbers(0, 0);
        for (int i = 1; i <= 6; i++) {
            Collections.sort(bucket[i]);
        }
        power[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 12; i++) {
            power[i] = power[i - 1] * 10;
        }
        processNumber(0);
        System.out.println((result + MOD2) % MOD2);
    }
}
